constraints: plans/00_review_report.md (C1, C3, C6, C7, C11, C15 and the Plan 2 items)
status: Fixed before any regression, forecast, decomposition, or comparison between periods or star classes was run on the panel. What had been looked at: the Day-1 audit (coverage, value ranges, supply changes, latest-month values).
deviation_rule: Any departure from this file is listed, with its reason, in the report and in the output of the step where it happens. The file is not edited after results are seen; a correction gets a new spec_version and a new freeze.

scope.claims: descriptive, associational, and predictive; no causal claim
scope.wording: 'associated with' and 'conditional association'; not 'effect', 'impact', 'driver', or 'elasticity'. SHAP values describe model behaviour only.

data.outcome: occupancy_pct (average occupancy rate of guest rooms, percent)

variables.log_visitors_overnight: natural log of overnight visitor arrivals
variables.international_share_pct: 100 × (1 − (Chinese mainland + Hong Kong + Taiwan) / all visitors), by place of issue of the travel document
variables.package_tour_share_pct: 100 × visitors on package tours / all visitors
variables.log_rooms: natural log of guest rooms of the star class at month end
variables.cn_holiday_days: days of the month inside a mainland public-holiday period (State Council notices; declared days off plus adjoining free weekend days)
variables.cn_golden_week_days: the same, counting Spring Festival and National Day periods only
variables.cn_holiday_days_at_origin, cn_golden_wee: the two counts above as scheduled by the notices published up to the end of the month before; these are the calendar features of the forecasts, the final counts are used in the ex-post regression
variables.typhoon_days: days of the month with tropical cyclone signal No. 8 or higher in force

data.star_classes: DSEC's four classes as published. Establishments move in and out of a class over time; no class is merged, dropped, or re-labelled, and rooms per class enter as the supply variable.
data.revisions: values are those DSEC published on the download date in the manifest

change_points.use: drawn on the timeline; never an input to a regression or a forecast. The period boundaries above come from the plan, not from PELT.

eda.scatter: occupancy_pct against log_visitors_overnight, by star class and period

regression_h1_h2.role: ex-post description of the same-month association; not a forecast
regression_h1_h2.sample: main sample: pre-pandemic and post-pandemic months, all four classes
regression_h1_h2.model: occupancy_pct[i,t] = a[i] + a_post[i]·post[t] + month-of-year[t] + (b[i] + b_post[i]·post[t])·log_visitors_overnight[t] + (c + c_post·post[t])·same_day_share_pct[t] + controls + e[i,t]

terms.a[i], a_post[i]: star-class intercepts and their post-pandemic shifts
terms.month-of-year: eleven calendar-month indicators, common to all classes
terms.b[i], b_post[i]: class-specific slopes on log overnight visitors
terms.c, c_post: common slope on the same-day share

regression_h1_h2.controls_note: controls have one coefficient each, common to classes and periods

standard_errors.bandwidth_rule: floor(4 × (T / 100)^(2/9)), T = months in the sample
standard_errors.lag_counting: in calendar months, so no autocovariance is taken across the gap between December 2019 and January 2023

regression_h1_h2.inference: two-sided, alpha 0.05, normal reference; 95% CI for every coefficient

H1.statement: after the pandemic, the association between log overnight visitors and occupancy differs between 5-star and 3-star hotels

H2.statement: the association between the same-day share and occupancy differs between the post-pandemic and the pre-pandemic period

confirmatory_tests.multiplicity: Holm over the two tests above

secondary_tests: equality of the four post-pandemic slopes b[i] + b_post[i] (3 df)
Chow-type test: the five post interactions on the two focal regressors are jointly zero (5 df)

sensitivity_analyses.S1_pandemic_included: add 2020-01 to 2022-12 with their own period indicator, interacted like post
sensitivity_analyses.S2_logit_outcome: outcome logit(occupancy_pct / 100); signs and tests are compared, AIC/BIC are not compared across the two scales
sensitivity_analyses.S5_fully_interacted: controls and month indicators also interacted with post

reported: Ljung–Box on residuals per star class, lags 12 and 24
diagnostics.rule: reported only; the model, the standard errors, and the tests are not changed on the basis of a diagnostic p-value

forecast_h3.task: forecast occupancy_pct of month t+1 for each star class from data up to t
forecast_h3.training_rows: target months up to the origin in the pre-pandemic and post-pandemic periods; lagged features keep their observed values even when the lagged month is in the pandemic period
leakage_rules: no variable dated at the target month enters a forecast, except the known calendar features
typhoon days of the target month are never a feature
nothing is scaled, encoded, or selected using rows after the origin
orders and hyperparameters are chosen on validation origins only
each test origin is forecast once, after those choices are fixed
forecast_h3.information_set: pseudo-out-of-sample: the forecast of month t+1 uses the DSEC values of months up to t as published on the download date. DSEC's publication lag and later revisions are not reproduced, so the errors are not those of a forecast made in real time. The holiday features are the exception: they follow the notices published by the end of month t.

models.seasonal_naive: forecast = occupancy of the same month one year earlier

sarimax.fit: one model per star class, refit at every origin
sarimax.pandemic_months: occupancy of 2020-01 to 2022-12 treated as missing
sarimax.trend: constant when no differencing is used, none otherwise
sarimax.selection: per star class, lowest validation MAE; a candidate that fails to converge at any validation origin is dropped; ties go to the earlier candidate in the lists above; AIC/BIC are not used because the candidates differ in differencing

lightgbm.fit: one global model for the four classes, refit at every origin
lightgbm.selection: lowest validation MAE pooled over classes; ties go to the earlier grid point

metrics.mase_scale: per star class, mean absolute 12-month difference of occupancy over months up to 2024-06 for which both the month and the month one year earlier are in the main sample; fixed for all origins

units: pooled: mean loss over the four classes per origin
tests.multiplicity: Holm over all ten tests (2 comparisons × 5 units)
tests.h3_rule: H3 is supported if LightGBM has the lower pooled test MAE against both baselines and both pooled Holm-adjusted p-values are below 0.05. Otherwise H3 is reported as not supported, with the MAE differences and their 95% CIs.

sensitivity_analyses.F1_logit: SARIMAX and LightGBM fit on logit(occupancy_pct / 100); forecasts are back-transformed and all metrics are computed in percentage points
sensitivity_analyses.F2_pandemic_included: pandemic-period target months kept in LightGBM training and observed in SARIMAX

shap.model_explained: the LightGBM model fit at each test origin
shap.background: the training window of that origin only
shap.check: base value + sum of SHAP values equals the forecast within 1e-6
